Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"id": null, "name": "{{mission_name}}", "storeId": "{{STORE_ID}}", "status": "Draft", "public": true, "periodicity": "Monthly", "startDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "endDate": "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z", "dynamicExpression": {"id": "LoyaltyMissionConditionAndRewardTree", "children": [{"id": "BlockLoyaltyMissionCondition", "children": [{"id": "AnyUserGroupCondition"}]}, {"id": "BlockLoyaltyMissionGoals", "children": [{"id": "OrderCountGoal", "count": 3}]}, {"id": "BlockLoyaltyReward", "children": [{"id": "FixedAmountReward", "amount": 50}]}]}}
